'''Ewal Coplin''' is an [[Emond's Field]] resident.

== History ==
[[Rand al'Thor]] gives Ewal a black eye for teasing Rand about his gray eyes.{{ref/book|1|4}}

==Activities==
Ewal, along with [[Darl Coplin|Darl]], [[Hari Coplin|Hari]], [[Dag Coplin]], and [[Wit Congar]], go with Lord [[Slayer#Luc Mantear|Luc]] to bother a band of [[Whitecloak]]s.{{ref/book|4|43}}
